info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Education Enrollments Waitlists-v3-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Waitlist API provides access to the current waitlist for education enrollments, enabling efficient management of student inquiries and placements. Users can retrieve detailed information about students on waitlists, including their status and relevant enrollment details. This API is particularly useful for educational institutions and administrative staff tasked with overseeing enrollment processes and communicating updates to prospective students. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can streamline their enrollment strategy and enhance the overall experience for students during their wait for admission.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current waitlist for course enrollments. You can use this information to understand the demand and manage your enrollment strategies effectively.
